name: html-design-system
description: Decides which design system to build, then builds and verifies a complete, accessible HTML/CSS design system: DTCG tokens, up to 306 components, Storybook, DESIGN.md, MCP server, npm package and CI. Ports it to SwiftUI, Compose, Flutter and React Native from a measured spec, and builds icon sets.

new.content: Use the html-design-system skill to create a new design system. Arguments: $ARGUMENTS (optional tier and scopes). Start with Phase 0 (discover) and Phase 1 (decide).

extend.content: Use the html-design-system skill in extend mode on $ARGUMENTS: run `ds.py detect` and `ds.py audit` first, map the existing design into tokens, never overwrite project files.
extend.description: Turn an existing codebase's styles into a design system

adopt.content: Use the html-design-system skill in adopt mode with the reference system $ARGUMENTS (e.g. Carbon, Material 3, Fluent 2, Polaris).
adopt.description: Build on a reference design system

audit.content: Use the html-design-system skill to audit $ARGUMENTS: run `ds.py detect`, `ds.py audit`, and if a design system exists `ds.py check` and `ds.py coverage`, then report gaps. Do not modify files.
audit.description: Audit a project or design system (read-only)

resume.content: Use the html-design-system skill to resume the nearest design system: run `ds.py status` and `ds.py plan`, then continue from the recorded phase.
resume.description: Continue building an existing design system

mobile.content: Use the html-design-system skill to port the nearest design system to mobile ($ARGUMENTS: swiftui, compose, flutter, react-native, maui, web-mobile or all; optional app path). Follow references/mobile.md: `ds.py mobile spec`, `ds.py mobile scaffold --target …`, build the remaining components from dist/mobile/spec.json, `ds.py mobile lint`, then snapshot tests and `ds.py mobile verify` until it passes. Never hand-translate CSS values.
mobile.description: Port the design system to native apps with measured fidelity

icons.content: Use the html-design-system skill to work on icons for the nearest design system ($ARGUMENTS). Follow references/icons.md: `ds.py icons-add` from one library set, or draw missing icons to `icons/style.json` (`ds.py icons-style`) and check them with `ds.py icons-lint`; rebuild with `ds.py icons --platforms all`.
icons.description: Add icons from a library or draw new ones in the system's style
